scan_policy: Whole first-party current repository via rg; .git/venv/node_modules/datasets excluded. Historical reports/scratch are classified as archived copies, not active clients. No URI/secret argument values serialized.
limits: Static import/call graph is conservative, not a proof that every imported function executes in every process.
Dynamic collection helpers/aggregation lookups/exec-generated harnesses require source review and runtime command evidence.
A method named find may belong to a non-Mongo object unless its resource resolves.
